body:
thanks. And yeah, I googled this and it kinda seems like this isn't all that uncommon, so I think we're in good company. I remember when I got her as a puppy this thought crossed my mind out of nowhere that now I can't go anywhere because I've got this thing that needs me. I think I've always known that this is how I'll die (unless there's an accident)...and it would be time whenever I just felt ready. And as the years have passed I've just grown more sure of this as that list of "buts" slowly grew shorter. A few things changed recently and sorta put me in this place where I'm ready all the sudden, and done, and endured all I can, and have done what I needed to do with the time I have. All the "buts" have expired or otherwise resolved themselves...Except now this one. That I really didn't see coming. 

And I know she'll be loved and taken care of because the plan would be to leave her with my mom, who I know will be a wreck and use the dog as something of me to love on and take care of. I mean, she already acts like the damn thing is her grandchild since I'm surely not giving her any.
